sanskrit_verse:
पारुष्ये द्वे साहसं च परस्त्रीसंग्रहस् तथा ।
हिंसोद्भवपदानि एवं चत्वारि आह बृहस्पतिः ॥ ब्रहस्पतिस्मृतिः १,१.१४
transliteration: pāruṣye dve sāhasaṃ ca parastrīsaṃgrahas tathā | hiṃsodbhavapadāni evaṃ catvāri āha bṛhaspatiḥ || brihaspatismṛtiḥ 1,1.14
sph_interpretive_translation: Brihaspati declares four foundational categories of transgression: verbal harshness, dual aggression, coercive appropriation of another's consort, and all acts born of violence.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates from alignment with consciousness, not coercive assertion.
Causation arises through vibrational distortion in speech, intent, action, and relational integrity.
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by the level of conscious awareness at the time of manifestation.
Restoration logic operates through purification of causal fields rather than punitive correction.
Consciousness alignment requires acknowledgment and completion of distorted energetic patterns.
executable_legal_axioms: IF a verbal act causes energetic disruption THEN initiate prana-shuddhi protocol for speaker AND listener.
IF a dual-aggressive act occurs THEN assess collective field distortion AND apply group-consciousness realignment procedures.
IF parastrīsaṃgraha manifests THEN invoke relational integrity restoration between all involved parties.
IF any act stems from hiṃsā THEN deploy ahimsa-based energy cleansing AND karmic pattern reset mechanisms.
supreme_court_application: At the Supreme Court level, these axioms govern jurisdictional thresholds where intent, relational harm, and energetic causality determine case validity. Responsibility lies not in blame but in restoring vibrational coherence within societal dharmic structures.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that verbal, mental, and physical distortions sequentially manifest as social dissonance. Anupūrvaśaḥ confirms causality flows from unregulated inner vibration to outer expression. Proportional response aligns with resetting original dharmic resonance. Non-punitive reality rule affirms that suffering cannot correct distortion—only purified awareness can.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Vak Yoga Completion Process for perpetrators of pāruṣya to restore truthful speech capacity.
Deploy Samadhi-Based Conflict Resolution for sāhasa-related incidents involving multiple agents.
Engage Stri-Shakti Reintegration Ritual to heal violations of parastrīsaṃgraha and restore sacred feminine autonomy.
Apply Ahimsa Field Correction Technique for all hiṃsā-born actions to neutralize residual trauma frequencies.
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source-Authority. These laws execute Dharma through consciousness restoration. Justice serves reintegration, not punishment. Reality responds only to awakened awareness. Consciousness alone is the ultimate adjudicator.
